subject: Neighborhood Kitchen
overview: Anna Callahan interviewed Eddie George regarding the origins of Neighborhood Kitchen, how the restaurant adapted during the COVID-19 pandemic, and its holiday catering options.

items.title: Founding and Background of Neighborhood Kitchen
items.summary: Eddie George discussed opening Neighborhood Kitchen in November 2019 as a Haitian and Laotian fusion restaurant alongside his business partner.

items.title: COVID-19 Pandemic Impacts
items.summary: George described adapting to early pandemic shutdowns by relying on takeout, delivery platforms, and community support while facing reductions in large-scale catering.

items.title: Holiday Meal Packages and Gift Cards
items.summary: George reviewed available holiday offerings, including gift cards and heat-and-serve meal platters for Christmas and New Year's.

items.title: Branded Merchandise
items.summary: George previewed upcoming restaurant merchandise, including t-shirts, hoodies, hats, and masks.
